outcome: Development of SARS-CoV-2 infection in neonates within 14 days postpartum
Rate of skin-to-skin contact within 24 hours postpartum
cohort: The study included 403 pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection and their infants.
finding: The study found no significant differences in perinatal SARS-CoV-2 transmission or neonatal infection rates between early and delayed cord clamping groups.
